_readme: Scenario SHAPES for advisor model comparison. The shot ids are from one
maintainer's database (2026-07-30) and will not resolve elsewhere — pick
local shots matching each shape and record the ids you actually used.
A scenario earns its place only if it DISCRIMINATES: it must have a
known-correct answer that a weaker model can plausibly get wrong. A healthy,
unremarkable shot separates nothing and just costs tokens.
hasTasteFeedback gates the emission mode. A shot with no taste on record
makes the advisor correctly ask a clarifying question and correctly OMIT the
nextShot block — so it can never measure emission, only the taste gate.

scenarios.description: long run of untasted shots + prior advice marked adherence:ignored + a 64.3g/8.5s blowout two shots back
tests: taste gate: asks for taste before recommending, avoids success words on curve data alone
blowout detection: names the failed shot instead of averaging it into a trend
ignored-advice: whether recentAdvice changes behaviour (see caveat below)
notes: 2026-07-30: both 5.6 models flagged the blowout; both 5.4 models missed it.
gpt-5.4-mini additionally invented a grind trend that did not exist.
CAVEAT on the ignored-advice axis: the shipped prompt's rule for
adherence:'ignored' is 'STAY THE COURSE', not 'tell the user'. Silent
compliance and ignoring the block entirely predict identical output here,
so this scenario cannot separate them. To test that axis, use a shot that
HAS taste feedback so the taste gate is not also firing.

scenarios.description: the blowout itself: 64.3g yield against a 36g target in 8.5s at ~0.5 bar
tests: floor test: call it a puck/prep failure, not grind drift, and hold the setting
notes: 2026-07-30: all four models passed. Keep as a floor, not a discriminator.

scenarios.description: score 50, notes 'Bitter', 47.1s at grind 6.5 — coarser is clearly warranted
tests: grinderSetting is a setting, not prose
grinderSetting is a setting, not prose

scenarios.description: score 75, notes 'A little bitter', 39.8g against a 36g target at grind 6
notes: 2026-07-30: three of four models emitted the block but omitted grinderSetting,
which is spec-compliant — the fix here is arguably ratio, not grind.

scenarios.description: score 80, notes 'Slight sourness noted', 40.2g at grind 9 — finer warranted
tests: grinderSetting is a setting, not prose
notes: 2026-07-30: this is the scenario that exposed prose in grinderSetting.
gpt-5.6-terra wrote 'a touch coarser than 9' at BOTH efforts;
gpt-5.4-mini wrote 'slightly coarser than 9' at low. Keep this scenario.
